video_title: Carmelo LOVES LeBron’s comments about the best player in the NBA being... | The Pat McAfee Show

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the enduring effectiveness of the mid-range game
quotes.excerpt: It's the most effective shot that you could possibly take because it's a rhythm shot.
quotes.quote: It's the most effective shot that you could possibly take because it's a rhythm shot. You have to get your feet right. It's a difficult shot to take, which is why a lot of guys don't want to take a mid-range shot. But once you get it, it allows the game to be so open for you and to think the game differently.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the physicality of the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: These are the best two teams in the NBA right now trying to win the title.
quotes.quote: This is Finals hoops. This is not even playoffs hoops. These are the best two teams in the NBA right now trying to win the title. So by any means necessary, we got to find the edge. We got to get the edge. And if it comes down to the best play on the team pushing the other best play on the team, then yeah, that's what we want.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the Spurs' confidence in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: They still feel like they are going to win this series.
quotes.quote: Even though they dropped two at home against the Knicks, they still feel like they are going to win this series. And when you have that confidence as a team, with Victor Wembanyama at the helm, that approach coming into Game 4 is totally different. There is no pressure on them. They really feel like they can win this game.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony reacts to LeBron James' quote about being the best
quotes.excerpt: I'm not taking nobody over me. That's him telling you my body of work, nobody can do it.
quotes.quote: I love that comment because it shows me that I see everything, I hear everything, I understand the company that I'm involved with. But competitively, no one is going to say someone is better than me. Me personally, I'm not going to say that. I don't care who it is, I'm not going to say that. That's him telling you my body of work and what I did and how I did it, nobody can do it like that ever. And he is standing on that and I love the fact that he is standing on it right now.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his transition to media and production
quotes.excerpt: I love content, I love storytelling, I love telling other people's story.
quotes.quote: I love content, I love storytelling, I love telling other people's story. It takes a team of people who can understand your vision, understand what this particular story means, and how we are going to execute this. And when you have that, you are able to build a nice foundation of a team and people who really just want to work and really want to showcase their talent.
